text: 恒指收涨0.44%，恒科指涨1.08%。成交额居前个股中，阿里巴巴-W跌2.87%，腾讯控股跌0.14%，智谱涨11.11%，小米集团-W涨1.66%，中芯国际涨2.61%。
text_en: The Hang Seng Index closed up 0.44%, and the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 1.08%. Among the stocks with the highest turnover, Alibaba-W fell 2.87%, Tencent Holdings slipped 0.14%, Zhipu rose 11.11%, Xiaomi Group-W gained 1.66%, and SMIC rose 2.61%.
